    my servant Edward Partridge, and give unto him directions, for
    it must needs be that he receive directions how to organize this
    people;

Hearken unto me, saith the Lord your God, and I will speak unto my servant Edward Partridge, and give unto him directions ; for it must needs be that he receive directions how to organize this people ; for it must needs be that they be organized according to my laws; if otherwise, they will be cut off. Wherefore, let my servant Edward Partridge, and those whom he has chosen, in whom 1 am well…

all hands were up. I thought, while witnessing this spectacle, “What harm is there in a people being of one heart and one mind?” but, to use a common phrase, I could not see the point. I cannot discover any iniquity in a people's being one. If they are disposed to chose evil instead of good, sin instead of righteousness, darkness instead of light, falsehood instead of truth, where is the utility…
